notes.subject: הראש/הזנב
notes.rationale: mutwe na mkia — kĩng'anĩrĩro gĩa kũingĩha kwa mbũtũ ya Israeri, mũthemba ũrĩa ũhoro wa thĩinĩ mũno ndũrĩkaga na ciugo cia Kĩgĩkũyũ cia kĩnanda

notes.subject: ונשוא פנים
notes.rationale: hihi nĩ 'ũrĩa ooyo wake woĩ kũinwo' (mũndũ wa kũheo gĩtĩo) kana 'ũrĩa ooyo waigana-igana'; JPS 'the man of rank'

notes.subject: isaiah 9:14
notes.rationale: mũtaratara wa maandĩko: Kĩhibirania gĩa 9:14 (amũrĩru 9:15 gwethe) nĩkĩa kĩandĩkĩtwo ha hinya hĩndĩ ya Kĩhuruta iria-inĩ; KJV irĩa mbere 'the LORD will cut off' nĩ ya rũciaro 13

translation: Mũkũrũ na ũrĩa ooyo wake woĩ kũinwo, niwe mutwe; na mũrathi mũregani mbũgĩ, niwe mkia.

tokens.gloss: na ũrĩa ooyo wake woĩ kũinwo
